variety_description: A high-yielding, late maturity, medium height, medium slender grain variety, grown extensively in eastern India. With profuse tillering, the plant grows up to  30 cm water depth. Developed by Rajendra Agricultural University, Bihar, and released in 2007. Sturdy stem, good grain quality. Suitable for irrigated shallow medium and low lands ecosystem. Cultivated mainly in the wet season.
